'''Veritts''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Rebellion era]]. Veritts commanded the ''[[Carnifex]]'', and at one point fabricated a plan to capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] by having [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report a fake story involving a missing shipment of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="RECG" />
